standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-dossier (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: a dossier is an evidential plate: one plate holding a few section cells; what the dossier has reached is stated, and what stays open is not closed by the scene

entities.plate: one square as the dossier plate
entities.cells: three small squares inside the plate — the evidential cells; a quiet constant across the family
entities.entity_ceiling: never more than 10 formations per scene (native limit; 4 is this family's max)

text_layers.editorial_card: kicker '<record_id> · <CLAIM_STATUS uppercase>' (compound statuses kept, e.g. dossier-formal-limit's 'Argued; specified formal consequences Derived under their stated assumptions') · title · italic = the record's declared source_relation
text_layers.body: the dossier's governing finding (#0 opening), compressed from the record only

variation_rules: the dossier family is deliberately the quietest episteme grammar — the plate does not dramatise
cell placement is constant; variation would imply an evidential difference that does not exist
